record.title: Guinea Sierra Leone security closure preceding February 2021 agreement
record.crossings: Pamelap operational reopening observed; broader bilateral frontier covered by agreement
record.enforcement: ConakryNews correspondent reports reopening at Pamelap around 08:00 on 18 February 2021.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.official_rationale: Guinea reassessed security after bilateral assurances.
record.context: Bilateral security/customs agreements accompanied planned reopening at 08h GMT.
record.uncertainty: UNOWAS report explicitly dates closure September 2020, corroborating contemporary Guinéenews security talks. ConakryNews retrospectively says after October 18 election and Sierra Leone Telegraph says early last year; these weaker conflicting onset accounts remain disclosed. Observed February 18 endpoint is Pamelap only.
